description: This file declares the StateObserver class, which provides an interface for observing and managing device states and properties. It includes method declarations for getting values, registering and unregistering listeners, setting and getting API version numbers, and handling state change events. It also defines constants representing system property keys.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A class providing an interface to get and set device properties and handle state change notifications within a plugin framework.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves current values for specified device properties based on input parameters.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers event listeners for specified device properties.

methods.name: unregisterListeners
methods.description: Unregisters event listeners for specified device properties.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the current API version number.

methods.name: getRegisteredPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns a list of registered property names.

methods.name: getNameWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the plugin.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends notifications about state changes to subscribed clients.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets a specific property with given state and error codes.

methods.name: onReportStateObserverEvents
methods.description: Static callback function for handling reported state observer events.
